trades.reasoning: RH has all four confirmation signals (MACD crossover, RSI 57.6 with room below 70, price above SMA-20, volume surge), so it is a measured way to put idle cash above the $500 threshold to work in an open slot without chasing an overbought name like CDW at RSI 68.

decisions.briefing: Markets eased slightly in light holiday-week trading, with the NASDAQ down 0.6% and the S&P 500 down 0.3%, so today is neutral rather than risk-off. The portfolio is up about 50% overall, so we are holding all seven positions and letting the automatic profit targets and stop-losses manage them. We are adding one medium-conviction position in RH, the only fully confirmed candidate that isn't near overbought, and keeping the other two slots for a stronger risk-on day.

market_education.summary_en: Stocks drifted modestly lower, with tech-heavy NASDAQ names giving back a bit more than the broader S&P 500, which often happens when traders lock in gains. Trading around the US Thanksgiving holiday is usually thin, so small moves like these tend to reflect positioning and profit-taking rather than a change in the big picture. No news headlines came with today's data, so we cannot tie the move to a specific catalyst.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日小幅回軟，科技股比重較高的納指跌幅略大於標普500，反映部分資金趁高位獲利回吐。適逢美國感恩節假期前後，市場交投普遍淡靜，這類溫和波動多屬倉位調整及獲利了結，未必代表大市趨勢逆轉。由於今日未有相關新聞資料，暫時未能將走勢歸因於特定消息。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Around holidays like Thanksgiving, many big investors are away, so fewer shares change hands. With less trading, prices can move on small orders, and those moves say less about where the market is really heading. That's why it makes sense to act cautiously on holiday days, for example by making one measured buy instead of filling every open slot at once.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 每逢感恩節等假期，不少大型機構投資者休假，市場成交量隨之萎縮。成交稀疏時，少量買賣盤已足以推動股價，因此這段期間的升跌對大市真正走向的參考價值較低。投資者在假期市況宜審慎部署，例如只作單一適量買入，而非一次過填滿所有空倉位。
